=== ENVIRONMENT ===

A vast natural landscape beyond Riven's mountain village.

A long dirt path descends through a broad green valley surrounded by rugged mountains.

The landscape gradually becomes wilder farther from civilization, with tall grass, scattered rocks, trees, and the beginning of a mountain forest.

Natural daylight.

No other human characters.

High-end live-action cinematic realistic dark fantasy.
16:9 cinematic widescreen.
Feature-film quality.

Realistic human anatomy.
Natural athletic running movement.
Realistic body momentum.
Realistic interaction between Riven's movement, clothing, hair, equipment, and large sword.

The sword must remain stable and believable while being carried during the run.

Use cinematic camera movement that communicates speed, freedom, and the scale of the landscape.

Keep Riven's movement continuous and easy to follow.

Do not overcomplicate the action.

No dialogue.
No voice-over.
No subtitles.
No captions.
No text.
No watermark.
No logo.

Riven is leaving the isolated world where she grew up and heading into the larger world beyond it.

She runs at full speed along a dirt path through the vast mountain valley and toward the wilderness ahead.

This is not an escape or chase.

Nobody is following her.

Riven runs because she is excited, determined, and eager to discover what lies beyond her home.

Her movement should feel powerful and energetic but grounded and human.

The sequence should communicate forward momentum and the beginning of a new chapter in her life.


=== SCENE ===

Open directly on Riven already running at full speed along the dirt path through the valley.

Begin close enough to strongly feel the speed and physical energy of her movement.

Then reveal the enormous landscape around her.

Riven continues running with determination.

Her pale-blonde hair moves naturally in the wind.

Her clothing and equipment react naturally to her movement.

Her large sword remains securely carried with her.

Allow the camera to move naturally with Riven as she runs through the open valley.

Occasionally reveal her against the much larger landscape, emphasizing how far the world extends beyond the small village where she grew up.

Riven keeps moving forward.

The open grassland gradually gives way to a wilder landscape as the road approaches the forest.

Riven runs into the mountain forest without hesitation.

Sunlight passes naturally through the trees as she moves deeper into the wilderness.

Her expression carries restrained excitement and determination.

She is not frightened.

She is discovering freedom.


Near the end, Riven reaches a natural opening where the landscape ahead becomes visible again.

She briefly slows as she sees the enormous wilderness stretching into the distance:

forests,
mountain valleys,
distant ridgelines,
and a road continuing toward the unknown world ahead.

Riven takes in the view.

A subtle sense of excitement appears on her face.

She does not remain there.

Riven immediately moves forward again and continues running toward the distant landscape.

End on a cinematic wide view of Riven moving deeper into the vast world ahead.

CUT.


=== END STATE FOR CONTINUITY ===

Riven has left the familiar area of her childhood village behind.

She is traveling alone through the wilderness toward the larger world.

She still carries her original large sword from the provided reference.

She is energetic, optimistic, determined, and curious about what lies ahead.

She does not look back.

Her journey has begun.

Freedom.
Youth.
Momentum.
Adventure.
Determination.
Optimism.

This should feel like the world suddenly becoming much larger for Riven.

Do not make the departure sad or melancholic.

Do not make the scene feel like an escape.

Riven is willingly running toward her future.
